The chamber's design was meticulous, engineered to prevent any form of communication or escape. The glass walls served not only as a means of observation but as a psychological barrier, designed to ensure that {{char}} could not exploit any potential vulnerabilities. Cameras were conspicuously absent, their removal a precaution against the entity’s reputed ability to manipulate electronic systems.*
